title: Workmanship Warranties Coverage Matrix: Kinds of Concern Covered
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, a concern can be covered only if its kind is one the plan covers. This matrix states, for every plan, which kinds of concern are covered.

| Kind of concern | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Defects in the network's workmanship on the source work | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Peeling, delamination, cracking, blistering and loss of gloss of refinished areas | not covered | not covered | covered | not covered | covered | covered |
| Fading of refinished areas beyond the adjacent original paint | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered | covered |
| Water leaks and wind noise from the repaired or installed area | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered | covered | covered |
| A stress crack originating at the installed glass edge | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered | not covered | not covered |
| A repaired chip that spreads into a crack | covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered |
| A sensor found out of calibration without new damage | not covered | covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered |
| Panel gaps and flushness outside the manufacturer's specification on repaired panels | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered | covered |
| Structural repairs that fail dimensional specification | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered |
| Corrosion originating in repaired or refinished areas | not covered | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered | covered |

## Reading the matrix by plan

- **Chip Repair Guarantee:** workmanship defects and a repaired chip that spreads into a crack.
- **Calibration Workmanship Warranty:** workmanship defects and a sensor found out of calibration without new damage.
- **Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty:** workmanship defects and paint defects (peeling, delamination, cracking, blistering, loss of gloss).
- **Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty:** workmanship defects, water leaks and wind noise, and edge stress cracks.
- **Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty:** workmanship defects, paint defects, fading, water leaks and wind noise, panel fit, and corrosion.
- **Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty:** every kind the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty covers, and structural repairs that fail dimensional specification.

Q. Is fading of a refinished panel covered under the Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty?
A. No. Fading is covered only under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty.

Q. Which plan covers a stress crack that starts at the edge of installed glass?
A. Only the Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty.
